summary: A London dental centre appears to lose new patients to opening hours that read Saturday until 02:00 and a 2023 date.

findings.problem: The opening hours appear to say Saturday 09:00 to 02:00.
findings.cost: A patient checking Saturday hours sees 2 in the morning, which looks like a typo and makes them call or choose another practice.

findings.problem: The footer appears to say Copyright 2023 Mulgrave Dental.
findings.cost: An old date makes a patient wonder if the practice is still active.

findings.problem: No online booking form appears next to the Book Appointment link.
findings.cost: Patients who want to book after hours cannot, and they book where they can.
findings.fix: Online booking on the page and a one tap text button.
